steps.en: Get SGLang on a GPU host: the Docker image or a uv install
steps.zh: 在 GPU 主机上装好 SGLang：Docker 镜像或 uv 安装
steps.code: docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:latest · uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang

steps.en: Start one server on your model
steps.zh: 在你的模型上启动一个服务

steps.en: Loads the weights and opens an OpenAI-compatible API on :30000
steps.zh: 加载权重，在 :30000 开放 OpenAI 兼容 API

steps.en: Point your existing OpenAI client at it, adding a JSON schema where output must parse
steps.zh: 把 OpenAI 客户端指过去，要可解析的请求带上 schema

steps.en: Batches requests and reuses the cached prefix any earlier request already computed
steps.zh: 把请求合批，复用之前请求已算好的相同开头

steps.en: Blocks any next token that would break the schema, so the reply always parses
steps.zh: 挡掉会破坏 schema 的下一个 token，回复必然能解析

value.en: Repeated prompts stop costing GPU time and structured replies stop needing retries
value.zh: 重复的开头不再白耗 GPU，结构化回复不再需要重试

sources: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang#get-started (docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:latest, uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang)
